Tuga A6 vs Tuga WH6

The Android A6 is £350 cheaper, better sealed, lighter and has a Zebra 2D scan engine built in; the Windows WH6 earns its extra cost when you need a desktop program or a network drive in the field.

Tuga A10 vs Tuga W10

The A10 is £200 cheaper, sharper, 517g lighter and rated IP68 and MIL-STD-810H; the W10 adds Windows 11 Pro, RJ45 Ethernet, HDMI and a removable battery for engineers who plug into panels and plant.
